name: relative-in-graph-absolute-at-tools
body: DESIGN DECISION [with user]: the durable graph stores the repo-relative identity; the suite tools resolve it to an absolute path at their boundary against the project `directory` they are given. Rationale: the artifact stays portable, while agents and editors keep receiving real absolute paths they can open. Consequence/scope: raw `apg query` is the graph view and returns the stored relative fqn; only the curated suite tools (`apg_file_path`, `apg_file_units`, `apg_hunk`, …) re-base. The cached fragment format already stores checkout-relative paths and rebases absolute fqns (`rust.apg.cache.rebase`), so this promotes the cache's existing model to the whole graph.
